steps.text: This recipe will make about 8 cups. Work in batches to best fit your blender.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and quarter apples, removing seeds and stem; peel the bananas. Add both to blender.
Wash, dry, peel, and slice ginger. (If you have a high powered blender, you can put the chunk in whole).
Halve and pit the avocados. Using a spoon, scoop the flesh into the blender.
Add spinach, almond milk, maple syrup, and 8 ice cubes to the blender.
Blend on high speed for several minutes until smooth.
Pour the smoothie into glasses and enjoy!
